blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — For days, victims thought they had simply lost their wallets to bad luck. But a single phone call from a vigilant local attorney has unraveled what police described as a series of credit card thefts. This gave several Cebuano citizens a chance to confront the person who allegedly took their cards. On Wednesday, October 14, three more complainants walked into the Mabolo Police Station, finally getting answers to how their wallets had disappeared. They identified the woman standing behind the counter, 43-year-old Kat, a former Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW), as the one who allegedly stole their belongings, […]...
